questions.question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

Priya said, "Yes, I am confounded."

options.text: Priya admitted that she was confound.
Priya admit that she was confounded.
Priya admitted that she was confounded.
Priya admitted that she is confounded.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e. 'Priya admitted that she was confounded.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in **Direct Speech**. As per the given directions, we have to change it into** Indirect Speech.**
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be added and comma and inverted commas will be removed.
 
• In the Indirect speech 'said' will be changed into 'admitted' because in the reporting speech the word **'yes'** is used to express acknowledgement.
 
• The indirect speech will begin like 'Priya admitted that.'
 
• Now we have to change the reported speech.
 
• In the reported speech, the pronoun 'I' will be changed to 'she.'
 
• The simple present tense 'am confounded' will be changed to the simple past tense 'was confounded'.
 
• Finally, the indirect speech is 'Priya admitted that she was confounded.'
 
• So, the correct answer is option 3.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *Priya admitted that she was confounded.*

questions.question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

People speak Cantonese in Hong-Kong.

options.text: Cantonese was spoken in Hong-Kong by people.
Cantonese is being spoken in Hong-Kong.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. 'Cantonese is spoken in Hong-Kong.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the** active voice**. We have to change the sentence into **passive form.** 
 
• The given sentence is written in 'simple present tense.'
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• Active Voice: Subject + V1 + Object.
 
• Passive Voice: Object + am/is/are + V3 + by (preposition) + Subject.
 
 
 
• Let’s see another example:
 
 
• Active voice: Madhu writes a novel.
 
• Passive voice: A novel is written by Madhu.
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'People' and the object of the given sentence is 'Cantonese'.
 
• The subject 'People' is not a definite subject, as it is a common noun. So we can omit the subject in passive voice.
 
• So, in the passive voice, the position of ‘subject’ and ‘object’ will be interchanged. 
 
• Also here, 'speak' will be changed into 'is spoken'.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *Cantonese is spoken in Hong-Kong.*

• Sentence Q is the second sentence that talks about** "recognition of climate change issues."** This suggests that the report is going to discuss the issue of climate change and the need for action. Thus it establishes a relation with the previous sentence.
 
• The only option that shows such an arrangement is Option 4.
 
• Sentence R is the third sentence as it begins with the conjunction** "and."** It indicates that the report is going to discuss the role of nuclear power in reducing emissions from electricity generation. Thus it provides additional information about the report.
 
• Sentence S is the last sentence as it ends with** "reducing emissions from electricity generation."** This phrase ties together the previous parts of the sentence and suggests that the report is going to discuss how nuclear power can help in reducing emissions.

questions.question:
**The question below consists of a set of labeled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

P. Many deadwood beetle species recycle the nutrients of woodlands.

Q. Some deadwood beetles are predators or parasitoids to other insect species and restrict population growth of potential pests.

R. Others have recently been found to be pollinators.

S. Working alongside fungi, bacteria and other invertebrates, they break down dead wood and return the nutrients back to the soil.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. "PSQR."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the abovementioned paragraph, there is a chronological sequence of the sentences.
 
• Sentence P is the first sentence as it begins with the **noun 'Many deadwood beetle species'** and mentions that they recycle the nutrients of woodlands. Thus highlighting their purpose in the ecosystem.
 
• Sentence S is the second sentence as it begins with the **gerund 'Working'** and introduces the idea that deadwood beetles work alongside fungi, bacteria and other invertebrates to break down dead wood and return the nutrients back to the soil. By giving detailed information it establishes a relation with the previous sentence.
 
• The only option that shows such an arrangement is Option 1.
 
• Sentence Q is the third sentence as it begins with the noun 'Some deadwood beetles' and mentions Some deadwood beetles are parasitoids or predators of other insect species, which helps control the spread of pest insects. Thus it gives exceptionally additional information in regard to the previous sentence. 
 
• Sentence R is the last sentence and mentions that some deadwood beetles have recently been found to be pollinators, which adds to the diversity of their roles in ecosystems. Thus it establishes a relation with the previous sentence.
 
• 
 
Thus, the correct answer is Option 1.​

 

The correct order is:__ 

**P. **Many deadwood beetle species recycle the nutrients of woodlands.

**S.** Working alongside fungi, bacteria and other invertebrates, they break down dead wood and return the nutrients back to the soil.

**Q.** Some deadwood beetles are predators or parasitoids to other insect species and restrict population growth of potential pests.

**R. **Others have recently been found to be pollinators.
